name: tia_create_plc_tag_table
description: Create a PLC tag table in an exact tag-table group; existing names are never overwritten.

table_name.description: Name for the new PLC tag table.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name; required when the project has multiple PLCs.

group_path.description: Exact parent tag-table-group path; omit or use an empty string for the root group.
